content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** WARRANTY — **deviation**, cured at the fallback level with one insertion.

- **What exists:** Article 10 gives only Effective-Date representations (10.1 mutual, 10.2 Harpoon-specific, Schedule-qualified) and covenants (10.3/10.4). Section 3.8.4 requires Development activities "in good scientific manner and in compliance with all Applicable Law," but that is a mutual compliance covenant, not a conformance warranty, and has no remedy attached.
- **What is absent:** no conformance warranty for Harpoon's deliverables (including the Final Development Report) or any software, no warranty period, and no repair/replacement/refund remedy anywhere in the document.
- **Disclaimer check:** 10.5 opens with "EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH HEREIN," so it does not swallow express warranties — no carve-out edit required, and none was made.
- **Cure:** new Section 10.6 inserted after 10.5, at fallback thresholds only (90 days software/deliverables, 30 days services) with repair, replacement, re-performance or refund. Preferred-only elements (12-month software period, compliance-with-laws, no malicious code) were deliberately not volunteered.
